final: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS FLOAT)) as avg_quantity, AVG(ABS(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost)) as avg_cost_diff FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code WHERE ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), mean_stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cost_diff) as overall_mean FROM category_stats), above_mean_stats AS (SELECT cs.avg_quantity, cs.avg_cost_diff, (cs.avg_cost_diff - ms.overall_mean) as excess FROM category_stats cs CROSS JOIN mean_stats ms WHERE cs.avg_cost_diff > ms.overall_mean) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as avg_of_avg_quantities, AVG(avg_cost_diff) as avg_of_avg_cost_diffs, AVG(excess) as avg_of_excesses FROM above_mean_stats
